children: Sweden industrial conglomerate's Q3 sales rose 8.3% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
Pretax profit beat analyst expectations, rising 17.7% yr/yr
Sales growth driven by acquisitions and organic expansion, especially in Transportation Products and Systems Solutions
Company expects lower Systems Solutions revenue and earnings in 2027 due to customer loss
Lifco says it has financial capacity to pursue further acquisitions
ACQUISITIONS AND ORGANIC GROWTH - Co said Q3 sales growth was driven by acquisitions and organic expansion
TRANSPORTATION PRODUCTS AND SYSTEMS SOLUTIONS - Co said acquisitions fueled sales growth in these segments
DENTAL AND SYSTEMS SOLUTIONS PROFITABILITY - Co said improved profitability in Dental and Systems Solutions contributed to margin expansion
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 5 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the consumer goods conglomerates peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Lifco AB (publ) is SEK352.00, about 10.4% above its October 22 closing price of SEK318.80
The stock recently traded at 32 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 34 three months ago
